items.title: Fiserv (FISV) Rebounds On Project Elevate As The Undervalued Narrative Builds
items.summary: Fiserv (FISV) is back in focus after announcing that Project Elevate will target US$1b in cost savings. The initiative is tied to 3,000 job cuts and reductions in senior management following pressure from activist investor Jana Partners. The share price reaction has been sharp. Fiserv’s 1-day share price return of 6.25% and 7-day gain of 29.65% come after earnings, goodwill impairment charges of US$6.45b and the Project Elevate update. items.title: Why Fiserv Stock Is In Focus After Earnings Beat And $1b Cost Cut Plan
items.summary: Fiserv reported third quarter 2026 results on November 3 that were broadly in line with expectations, reaffirmed full year guidance, recorded a US$6.45b non cash goodwill impairment and outlined flat to slightly lower GAAP revenue expectations for 2026. items.title: Fiserv (FISV) Adds Raj Seshadri to Board in Payments and Data Push
items.summary: Fiserv (NasdaqGS:FISV) has appointed Raj Seshadri, a former senior executive at Mastercard, to its Board of Directors. Seshadri brings experience leading commercial payments and data-focused businesses, alongside prior leadership roles at BlackRock and other financial institutions. Her background aligns with Fiserv's focus on unified commerce and embedded fintech as the board continues to evolve its mix of skills.
